name: The Last Day
source:
The female protagonist says goodbye to two male friends who live together on different floors of the same apartment before moving to a new place.

[From [url=https://citystream-studios.itch.io/the-last-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: 女主角即将搬去新住处，临行前向两位男友道别。他们住在同一栋公寓的不同楼层。[引自[url=https://citystream-studios.itch.io/the-last-day]Itch.io[/url]]
